question: Why can guest not create Grades (401) in UntisX (endpoint /homework)?
answer: Check role guest. Module Grades may require higher permissions. Error 401: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /homework and the database connection. Feature Grades must be enabled.
